warning.titlePre: Land Rover Defender P525 Known Issues by Engine
paragraphs: If your Defender P525 has the AJ133 (L663 generation):
Timing chain wear — Ingenium diesel engines share a well-documented timing chain pattern. We replace timing chains, guides and tensioners as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established specialist consensus, l663.guide specialist buying guide, what-breaks.com. This applies to L663 Defenders only — not to classic Defender models
